meta.title: Signer Census metrics for v1.signer (NEAR Chain Signatures)

method.ci: 95% percentile interval, cluster bootstrap within each month; census months are exact (no sampling error)

definitions.tx: transaction touching v1.signer via a FunctionCall (exact count from FastNEAR txs_count)
definitions.fulfilled: the callback (return_signature...) in the descendant receipts of THIS sign receipt succeeded
definitions.sign_receipt_failed_rate: share of sign receipts that the contract itself rejected (receipt status Failure, e.g. 'Signature request has already been submitted')
definitions.requester: predecessor_id of the sign receipt (not the tx signer)
definitions.requests_est: exact monthly tx total x (sign receipts per tx in the sample); ESTIMATE, not an exact count. Headline text should say '≈' and use rounded values.
definitions.requests_excluding_benchmark_est: requests minus requests of accounts labeled or suspected as benchmark/test in labels.yaml (tx-bench.near)
definitions.other_request_types: request-type calls on v1.signer other than `sign`, counted as receipts per tx x exact tx total; never added to the request count

caveats: Estimates come from clusters of consecutive txs starting at seeded random block heights; start points are uniform in block height, so txs that follow a long quiet gap are slightly over-represented (see robustness.density_weighted).
The CI captures between-cluster variability only; it does not capture that bias, label errors or dependence between adjacent months.
Requests are attributed to the month of their tx, not of callback execution.
Chain families and categories exist only where backed by evidence (labels.yaml, config/chain_rules.yaml); the rest is reported as 'unlabeled' / 'unknown'.

proximity_team_v1signer.reported_source: https://dune.com/proximity_team/v1signer (widget 1915729, query 5597462, column total_txns). Read from the public dashboard page on 2026-11-11 through an LLM-assisted page fetch; NOT verified against Dune itself and the SQL behind the query is not visible.
proximity_team_v1signer.reported_series: cumulative, 718 rows, first row 2024-10-01 = 212, last row 2026-09-21 = 6914449
proximity_team_v1signer.note: Their query/SQL is not visible, so the unit they count is unknown. 'closest_unit' only says which of our units is numerically closest at that date.

robustness.note: Sampling-only checks. The confidence intervals in this file capture between-cluster sampling variability, not the start-bias or definition risks discussed in docs/METHODOLOGY.md.
